name: Prussia

flag.description: A white field with a narrow black stripe along the top and bottom edges and, in the centre, the crowned black Prussian eagle holding a sceptre and an orb.
flag.symbolism: Black and white, the Prussian colours, are traditionally traced to the black cross on white of the Teutonic Knights, whose state in Prussia came before the duchy and kingdom.

hook: Prussia is a single black eagle on white between two thin black edge stripes; the Holy Roman Empire's eagle has two heads and sits on gold.
trivia: Prussia's black and white supplied the black and white of the German Empire's black-white-red flag, with the red taken from the Hanseatic cities.
The Allied Control Council formally abolished the state of Prussia in 1947.
